scope: Purposive six-case subset of existing public CP64-CP79; 5 corrected case interpretations and 1 intact comparator (CP66). Not a random sample or a new outcome dataset.

methods.existing_baseline: W3C PROV-O-style qualified attribution/version source with applicable NISO CRediT roles and unrestricted full-source free-text notes; no impoverished control.
methods.candidate: Same facts and source access with structured CCPH event/unknown/adverse/attrition/alternative-path/privacy labels.
methods.publication_boundary: The shared text contains no private individual-level records. Original publications retain their authors' rights. Source pages are linked rather than reproduced.

reassessment.retain: No claim of added accuracy until independent blinded comparison.
reassessment.expand: Freeze new cases and obtain independent source-grounded annotation with balanced budgets, privacy/rights review.
reassessment.stop: If strong baseline matches CCPH at less cost or CCPH raises unsupported causal attribution, narrow or drop added fields.
